snippet.title: Oh Apollo! Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4406930/Oh_Apollo/

Fulfill your role as the priestess of Apollo's oracle in Delphi and bring the temple back to glory in this cozy narrative management game.

Connect with Apollo, sharpen your prophecy deciphering and delivering skills, get to know your believers, visit beautiful lively spots in the city and collect decoration items while you see Delphi blooming thanks to your committed work.

Decorate your oracle room with gifts sent by satisfied believers as well as items that you have collected around the city! Every item has an effect on the overall perception that the general audience would have on the oracle, unlocking different events and reactions.
Listen to the believers that come to Apollo with their worries for getting divine advice and be careful of the answers you give to them. Every answer will position you on the side of the mortals or the gods – choose wisely who you want to please.
Consult with Apollo and listen to his words with attention. 
Visit the mythical city of Delphi and its beautiful locations to keep spreading the word about the temple, attract new petitioners and get to know locals and travellers!
Get to know Apollo, learn to work with him and you may discover a friendship that will last an eternity!
Check the results of your weekly work every morning before the oracle session starts at The Delphi Observer – as your prophecies can bring funny stories or critical eyes!

Play the Demo and wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4406930/Oh_Apollo/
